research.title: Ultrafast electron beams
research.text: I study short-pulse electron transport in vacuum and plasma, focusing on how space charge drives pulse broadening, energy spread, and phase-space distortion. My interests extend to beam–plasma acceleration in high-energy-density regimes.

research.title: Sheaths & surfaces
research.text: I model emission-driven plasma sheaths using fluid and kinetic approaches, including inverse sheath formation and the redistribution of particle fluxes at material interfaces relevant to fusion devices.

research.title: Differentiable plasma modeling
research.text: I develop and use fluid and kinetic solvers to connect physical models with simulations. My proposed next direction combines JAX, GPU computing, parameter inference, and neural surrogates for energy-efficient plasma discharge design.
